extraction.Name: Louis Ferrin
extraction.Refused/Protested: No, I did not know what it was until nearly a year afterward.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Yes, to W. H. Tackett for $3200.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I had no idea of securing a patent for this land and had not contemplated a sale but when I found that I had to pay tax I knew that it would be only a matter of time until I would lose it for the taxes, so I sold it.
extraction.NOTES: Records show consideration was $3500.00 but allottee states he received only $3200.00 and paid $75 tax. Patent was mailed to him at Lakeview, S.D. Wife and three children depend on him for support. Satisfied with the sale. Signed a receipt for the patent. Document notarized June 22, 1929; notary commission expires 4-28-32.
